topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I’ve been pouring over my designs, tweaking every detail, running simulations until the wee hours. It felt like a breakthrough, truly. My invention, a passion poured into countless revisions. But then, there it was, in a dusty corner of the patent office website, almost like a glitch in the fabric of my world. The specifications, the diagrams, eerily similar to mine. I told myself maybe it’s a coincidence, a strange loop of the universe. Yet, every revision I make now feels like I’m tracing steps already taken, paths well-trodden by someone else. The papers seem heavier, the lines more stark. I keep adjusting, hoping to find a new angle, a different path, but the shadow of those similarities lingers, shaping my every move.
